title: Handwoven Water Hyacinth Round Placemats | Natural Table Mats | GrassCrafts
descriptionHtml:
Handwoven Water Hyacinth Round Placemats — Earthy Elegance for Your Table

Add a touch of natural warmth to your dining table with these handwoven water hyacinth round placemats. Each mat is crafted by skilled Indian artisans, bringing organic texture and sustainable beauty to every meal.

Why You’ll Love Them

  • 100% natural water hyacinth — eco-friendly & biodegradable
  • Durable, breathable weave with a natural finish
  • Adds organic texture to any dining or coffee table
  • Lightweight & easy to clean
  • Handcrafted by Indian artisans — each piece unique

Dimensions

Diameter: 12 inches
